parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region for the instance.

parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the zone for the instance.

parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。

parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version. Valid values:

- **6.0**

- **7.0**
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to **gpdb**
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎，取值为**gpdb**
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. For more information, see the description of the `DBInstanceClass` parameter.

> This parameter is required for instances in reserved storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格，详细说明请参见DBInstanceClass参数补充说明。

> 创建存储预留模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The number of compute groups. Valid values: 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 64, 96, and 128.

> This parameter is required for instances in reserved storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
计算组数量。取值为：2、4、8、12、16、24、32、64、96、128。

> 创建存储预留模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: db_instance_group_count

parameters.help_en: The instance description
parameters.help_zh: 实例描述
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The IP address whitelist for the instance.

A value of 127.0.0.1 blocks all external access. After you create the instance, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86928.html operation to modify the IP address whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单。

127.0.0.1表示禁止任何外部IP访问，您可以在实例创建完成后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86928.html接口修改IP白名单
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the instance. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

- **Prepaid**: subscription.

> * If this parameter is not specified, the default billing method is pay-as-you-go.
>
> * Discounts are available for subscriptions of one year or longer. Select a billing method based on your business needs
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型，取值如下：

- **Postpaid**：按量付费
- **Prepaid**：包年包月

> - 如果不填，则会默认为按量付费。
> - 包年包月计费模式下，一次性购买一年及以上时长时会有一定优惠，建议您按需选择计费类型
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

- **Month**

- **Year**

> This parameter is required for subscription instances
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值如下：
- **Month**：月
- **Year**：年

> 创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

- If **Period** is **Month**, the value can be an integer from 1 to 9.

- If **Period** is **Year**, the value can be an integer from 1 to 3.

> This parameter is required for subscription instances
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。取值如下：
- 当**Period**为**Month**时，取值为1~9。
- 当**Period**为**Year**时，取值为1~3。

> 创建包年包月计费类型的实例时必须传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327176.html
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性校验。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/327176.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The instance network type. Set the value to **VPC**.

>
> - If this parameter is not specified, VPC is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
实例网络类型，取值为**VPC**。

> - 公共云仅支持VPC网络。
> - 如果不填，则默认为VPC类型
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID.

> - This parameter is required.
>
> - The VPC must be in the region specified by `RegionId`
parameters.help_zh:
VPC ID。

> - **VPCId**必填。
> - **VPC**所在地域必须与**RegionId**保持一致
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

> - This parameter is required.
>
> - The vSwitch must be in the zone specified by `ZoneId`

vSwitch ID。

> - **vSwitch**所在可用区必须与**ZoneId**保持一致

parameters.help_en:
The storage type for the segment nodes. Only ESSDs are supported. Set the value to **cloud\_essd**.

> This parameter is required for instances in elastic storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘存储类型，目前仅支持ESSD云盘，取值为：**cloud_essd**。

> 创建存储弹性模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: seg_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the ESSDs. Valid values:

- **pl0**: PL0

- **pl1**: PL1

- **pl2**: PL2

> * This parameter applies only if the segment node storage type is ESSD.
>
> * If this parameter is not specified, pl1 is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD云盘的性能级别，取值如下：

- **pl0**：PL0级别。
- **pl1**：PL1级别。
- **pl2**：PL2级别。

> - 仅磁盘存储类型为ESSD云盘时，该参数生效。
> - 如果不填，则默认为PL1级别
parameters.name: seg_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en:
The instance type for the compute nodes.

Valid values for a High-availability Edition instance in elastic storage mode:

- **2C16G**

- **4C32G**

- **16C128G**

Valid values for a Basic Edition instance in elastic storage mode:

- **2C8G**

- **4C16G**

- **8C32G**

- **16C64G**

Valid values for a serverless instance:

- **4C16G**

- **8C32G**

> This parameter is required for instances in elastic storage mode or serverless mode
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点规格。

存储弹性模式高可用版取值如下：
- **2C16G**
- **4C32G**
- **16C128G**

存储弹性模式基础版取值如下：
- **2C8G**
- **4C16G**：
- **8C32G**：
- **16C64G**

Serverless模式取值如下：
- **4C16G**
- **8C32G**

> 创建存储弹性模式实例和Serverless模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: instance_spec

parameters.help_en:
The number of compute nodes. Valid values:

- For a High-availability Edition instance in elastic storage mode, the value must be a multiple of 4, from 4 to 512.

- For a Basic Edition instance in elastic storage mode, the value must be a multiple of 2, from 2 to 512.

- For a serverless instance, the value must be a multiple of 2, from 2 to 512.

> This parameter is required for instances in elastic storage mode or serverless mode
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点个数，取值说明：

- 存储弹性模式高可用版取值范围为4~512，取值需为4的倍数。
- 存储弹性模式基础版取值范围为2~512，取值需为2的倍数。
- Serverless模式取值范围为2~512，取值需为2的倍数。

> 创建存储弹性模式实例和Serverless模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: seg_node_num

parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数

The instance resource mode. Valid values:

- **Serverless**: serverless mode

- **Classic**: reserved storage mode

parameters.help_zh:
实例资源类型，取值说明：

- **StorageElastic**：存储弹性模式。
- **Serverless**：Serverless模式。
- **Classic**：存储预留模式。

> 该参数必填
parameters.name: db_instance_mode

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

- **HighAvailability**: High-availability Edition

- **Basic**: Basic Edition

> This parameter is required for instances in elastic storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列。取值说明：

- **HighAvailability**：高可用版。
- **Basic**：基础版。

> 创建存储弹性模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: db_instance_category

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group for the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity for the instance, in GB. Valid values: <props="china">50 to 8000</props><props="intl">50 to 6000</props>.

> This parameter is required for instances in elastic storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
存储空间大小，单位GB，取值范围为<props="china">50~8000</props><props="intl">50~6000</props>
。

> 创建存储弹性模式实例必须传入该参数
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to load a sample dataset after the instance is created. Valid values:

- **true**: A sample dataset is loaded.

- **false**: A sample dataset is not loaded.

> If this parameter is not specified, a sample dataset is not loaded
parameters.help_zh:
是否在实例创建完成后，加载样本数据集，取值如下：

- **true**：加载样本数据集。
- **false**：不加载样本数据集。

> 如果不填，则默认为不加载样本数据集
parameters.name: create_sample_data

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. The following limits apply:

- The tag key cannot be empty.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。限制如下：

- 不允许为空字符串。
- 最多支持128个字符。
- 不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value. The following limits apply:

- The tag value can be empty.

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The tag value cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签值。限制如下：

- 可以为空字符串。
- 最多支持128个字符。
- 不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instance. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 第N个标签。N的取值范围：1~20
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for computing resources, in AnalyticDB Compute Units (ACUs). The value must be a multiple of 8, ranging from 8 to 32. The default value is 32.

> This parameter is required only for serverless instances that use auto-scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源阈值。取值范围8~32，步长为8，单位为ACU。默认值为32。

> 仅Serverless自动调度模式实例需传入该参数
parameters.name: serverless_resource

parameters.help_en:
The period of inactivity, in seconds, after which the instance is considered idle. Minimum value: 60. Default value: 600.

> This parameter is required only for serverless instances that use auto-scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
空闲释放等待时长。即当无业务流量的时长达到指定时长后，实例转为空闲状态。单位为秒，最小值为60，默认值为600。

> 仅Serverless自动调度模式实例需传入该参数
parameters.name: idle_time

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the serverless instance. Valid values:

- **Manual**: manual scheduling. This is the default value.

- **Auto**: auto-scheduling.

> * This parameter is required only for instances in serverless mode.
>
> * Auto-scheduling for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in serverless mode is in preview. To use this feature, [submit a ticket](https://smartservice.console.aliyun.com/service/create-ticket?product=rds) to be added to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless实例的模式，取值如下：

- **Manual**：手动调度，为默认值。
- **Auto**：自动调度。

> - 仅Serverless模式实例需传入该参数。
> - 云原生数据仓库 AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 版Serverless自动调度模式正在邀测中。如需使用，请您[提交工单](https://smartservice.console.aliyun.com/service/create-ticket?product=rds)申请邀测资格
parameters.name: serverless_mode

parameters.help_en:
The encryption type. Valid values:

- **NULL**: disables encryption. This is the default value.

- **CloudDisk**: Enables cloud disk encryption. If you select this option, you must also specify a value for `EncryptionKey`.

> After cloud disk encryption is enabled, it cannot be disabled
parameters.help_zh:
加密类型，取值说明：

- **NULL**：不启用加密（默认值）。
- **CloudDisk**：开通云盘加密，并通过**EncryptionKey**参数指定密钥。

> 当前云盘加密开启后无法关闭
parameters.name: encryption_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the encryption key.

> If `EncryptionType` is set to `CloudDisk`, you must specify the ID of an encryption key in the same region. Otherwise, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
密钥ID。

> 如果参数**EncryptionType**的值为**CloudDisk**则需要通过该参数指定同地域内的加密密钥ID，否则为空
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable vector engine optimization. Valid values:

- **enabled**: enables vector engine optimization.

- **disabled** (default): disables vector engine optimization.

> * For mainstream analytics, data warehousing, and real-time data warehousing scenarios, we recommend that you **disable** vector engine optimization.
>
> * For AIGC and vector search scenarios, we recommend that you **enable** vector engine optimization
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启向量引擎优化。取值说明：
- **enabled**：开启向量引擎优化。
- **disabled**（默认）：不开启向量引擎优化。

> - 对于主流分析场景、数仓场景、实时数仓等场景，建议**不开启**向量引擎优化。
> - 对于使用向量分析引擎用于AIGC、向量检索等场景用户，建议**开启**向量引擎优化
parameters.name: vector_configuration_status

parameters.help_en:
The resources for the coordinator node. Valid values:

- 2 CU

- 4 CU

- 8 CU

- 16 CU

- 32 CU

> You are charged for coordinator node resources of 8 CUs or more
parameters.help_zh:
Master资源，取值如下： 
- 2 CU 
- 4 CU 
- 8 CU 
- 16 CU 
- 32 CU 
> 8CU以上的master资源会产生费用
parameters.name: master_cu

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance to be cloned.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the destination region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
克隆源实例ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: src_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html operation to query the backup set IDs for the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html查看目标实例下所有备份集的备份集ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL encryption. Valid values:

- **true**: SSL encryption is enabled.

- **false** (default): SSL encryption is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SSL加密。取值说明：
- **true**：开启SSL加密。
- **false**（默认）：不开SSL加密
parameters.name: enable_ssl

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Valid values:

- **standard**: Standard Edition.

- **cost-effective**: Cost-effective Edition.

> If this parameter is not specified, the default value is standard
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值说明：
- **standard**：标准版。
- **cost-effective**：经济版。

>  如果不填，则会默认为标准版
parameters.name: prod_type

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode. Valid values:

- multiple: multi-AZ deployment.

- single: single-AZ deployment.

> * If this parameter is not specified, the default value is single.
>
> * Defaults to `single` (single-AZ deployment), which is the only mode currently supported
parameters.help_zh:
部署模式。取值说明：
- multiple：多可用区部署。
- single：单可用区部署。

> 
> - 如果不填，则会默认为单可用区部署。
> - 当前仅支持单可用区部署
parameters.name: deploy_mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the standby zone.

> - This parameter is required only for a multi-AZ deployment.
>
> - You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the IDs of available zones.
>
> - The standby zone must be different from the primary zone
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID。

> 
> - 仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
> - 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的可用区ID。
> - 备可用区ID必须与主可用区ID不一致
parameters.name: standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the standby zone.

> - This parameter is required only for a multi-AZ deployment.
>
> - The vSwitch must be in the standby zone specified in `StandbyZoneId`
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区VSwitch ID。

> 
> - 仅多可用区部署时需传入该参数。
> - 备可用区VSwitch ID所在可用区必须与StandbyZoneId保持一致
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
Use this parameter to configure the coordinator node as a MasterAI node.

> - This parameter and `MasterCU` are mutually exclusive.
>
> - This feature is available only in some regions and zones.
>
> - MasterAI nodes are supported only for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 Basic Edition instances.
>
> - For a list of all possible values, see the coordinator node specification change page in the console
parameters.help_zh:
如果您需要将 Master 节点变更为 MasterAI 节点，请指定该参数。
> - 该参数与 MasterCU 不能同时指定。
> - 仅部分地域和可用区均支持将 Master 节点变更为 MasterAI 节点。
> - 仅 AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0 版的基础版实例支持 MasterAI 节点。
> - 您可以在 Master 节点变配的售卖页面上查询该参数的所有可能取值
parameters.name: master_ai_spec

parameters.help_en: The AI node specifications
parameters.help_zh: AI节点规格信息

parameters.help_zh: Serverless缓存空间，单位为GB
